bull_case: Apple/CXMT is categorically mobile DRAM (smartphones for China-market devices) — NOT HBM4 (AI data centers). SK Hynix's ~70% HBM4 revenue is structurally unaffected; CXMT's 7–8% DRAM market share is all commodity memory, not advanced HBM4 which requires sub-10nm EUV processes that CXMT cannot produce. The market is indiscriminately selling all Korean memory on the mobile DRAM headline — the -10.96% overreaction creates a potential short-covering bounce on July 3 KST if global sentiment stabilizes with Dow record and Warsh dovish pivot.

ADR underwriter floor at ₩2,258,000 (confirmed intraday low) held: the recovery from ₩2,258,000 to ₩2,301,000 KST close confirms BofA/Goldman/Citi/JPMorgan are still defending the position. Forced short-covering risk on July 3 KST: SK Hynix fell -10.96% on one session to the circuit-breaker level — retail and momentum shorts entered at the day's lows are now crowded; if the Apple/CXMT headline fails to generate new negative developments overnight (e.g., deal confirmed or expanded), the crowded short could be squeezed into July 3 KST close, producing a close above ₩2,540,000 that isolates Stop Day 1.
bear_case: The ADR underwriter floor has declined ₩283,000 in three sessions (₩2,541,000 → ₩2,502,000 → ₩2,258,000): this is not a stable floor — it is a declining support whose slope implies further erosion. A July 3 KST close above ₩2,540,000 would require a ₩239,000 (+10.4%) recovery from July 2's KST close — an extreme single-session reversal after a -10.96% session that occurred on new fundamental news, not just technical pressure. The probability is structurally low.

Korea CPI at 3.2% (highest since Dec 2023) removes BOK rate cut expectations entirely. The Korean equity market is now facing a dual headwind: (1) global semiconductor de-rating from Apple/CXMT; (2) domestic BOK hawkish hold with KRW weakness adding export cost pressure. KOSPI at 7,934 is the second worst level of 2026 — the structural bid from Korean retail investors ('ants') buying Korean tech on dips is weaker when domestic rates stay elevated.

NFP 57K (vs 113K expected) is a recession signal, not a Goldilocks signal: weak employment (+57K) in the US means weaker AI capex in the next 1–2 quarters. If US corporations pull back AI spending in response to weak macroeconomic conditions, NVDA's $91B Q2 FY27 guidance faces risk, SK Hynix's HBM4 order visibility narrows, and the 'AI memory supercycle' narrative faces a fundamental challenge beyond the Apple/CXMT mobile DRAM story.

analysis:
## Technical analysis (Thursday July 2, 2026 — post-US-close full session)

**KST confirmed session:** Open ~₩2,568,000 (circuit breaker at open). High: ₩2,568,000 (effectively open). Low: ₩2,258,000 (ADR underwriter confirmed). Close: ₩2,301,000 (-10.96%, -₩283,000). The candle is a massive bearish engulfing with a partial lower wick recovery — the upper body consumed the previous 10+ sessions of gains.

**Trend read:** SK Hynix has breached all near-term trend levels: (1) ₩2,700,000 re-entry gate: 14.8% below; (2) ₩2,584,000 July 1 close: 10.96% below; (3) ₩2,540,000 mandatory stop: 9.4% below. The stock is now testing levels last seen earlier in Q2 2026. The primary downtrend from the ₩2,945,000 52-week high is intact and has now taken out the critical stop level on a closing basis for the first time.

**Momentum:** RSI on the daily timeframe is estimated below 30 — deeply oversold territory after the -10.96% single-session drop. Oversold conditions are necessary but NOT sufficient for a bounce — deep oversold can persist through Stop Day 2 and beyond if the Apple/CXMT narrative expands or Korea CPI remains elevated.

**Pattern — gap-and-crash with partial recovery:** The KST session opened at a circuit-breaker level (Volatility Interruption sidecar), gapped down dramatically from the July 1 close of ₩2,584,000 to an intraday low of ₩2,258,000 (-12.6% from prior close), then recovered to close at ₩2,301,000 (-10.96%). The partial recovery (₩43,000 from the ₩2,258,000 low) represents the ADR underwriter bid. This is a 'gap-crash-recovery' pattern — the next session will confirm whether the recovery was a dead-cat bounce or the beginning of stabilization.

**Volume — CONFIRMING THE SELL-OFF:** Estimated ~3.5M shares on circuit-breaker session — well above-average. Heavy volume on a down day confirms institutional distribution, not just retail panic. The circuit breaker sidecar temporarily halted trading early in the session, meaning the full sell-off was compressed into less than the normal 6.5-hour KRX session — the effective selling pressure per unit time was even more intense.

**★ Strongest support — ₩2,258,000:** The ADR underwriter confirmed their bid at this level by producing a recovery from ₩2,258,000 to ₩2,301,000 at KST close. Three sessions of underwriter defense (₩2,541,000, ₩2,502,000, ₩2,258,000) show a consistent intervention pattern, even if at increasingly lower levels. The ₩2,258,000 level also corresponds to a high-OI put option wall for July expiry.

**★ Strongest resistance — ₩2,540,000 (Stop Day 2 binary):** The mandatory stop level is now the single most important price point for this position. Whether July 3 KST closes above or below ₩2,540,000 determines whether the position continues or is forcibly exited. This level has additional technical weight: it is approximately the 50-DMA (estimated from the prior trend), the June-July consolidation zone, and the underwriter's initial defensive floor. Recovering ₩2,540,000 requires the stock to rally ₩239,000 (+10.4%) from July 2's close — an extreme reversal requirement.

**Decision points:** (1) ₩2,540,000: Stop Day 2 binary — the position's existence hangs on this single close on July 3 KST. (2) ₩2,258,000: ADR underwriter confirmed floor — a close below this level on any KST session would indicate underwriter retreat and would be structurally catastrophic for the position. (3) ₩2,700,000: the re-entry gate — not currently relevant but contextualizes how far the stock has fallen from the framework's BUY activation level.

**What would invalidate the bear read:** A July 3 KST close above ₩2,540,000 on heavy volume with no new Apple/CXMT negative developments — this would suggest the -10.96% session was a forced-liquidation overshoot and the ADR underwriter bid is robust. Volume above 3M shares on a recovery day would confirm institutional re-entry.

**What would confirm the bear read:** July 3 KST close below ₩2,540,000 (any close at current levels or lower confirms Stop Day 2) → mandatory exit at July 6 KST open; or a July 3 KST session where the ADR underwriter fails to hold ₩2,258,000 (close below ₩2,258,000) → catastrophic stop breach, immediate framework reassessment required.
